chapter.title: Rules fixed in advance
chapter.subtitle: Locked first, then the data
chapter.sub: Chapter nine: rules fixed in advance. Let's see which rules were locked, and when.
chapter.tts: Chapter nine, rules fixed in advance. Let's see which rules were locked, and when.

lines.sub: What I cared about most in this study is the order of events.
lines.tts: What I cared about most in this study is the order of events.

lines.sub: As the title says, the rules were locked first, then the data were extracted.
lines.tts: As the title says, the rules were locked first, then the data were extracted.

lines.sub: The thin line on the left, the stem, puts the commits to the public repository and the data extractions in time order.
lines.tts: The thin line on the left, the stem, puts the commits to the public repository and the data extractions in time order.

card.title: Commit
card.body: A saved, time-stamped snapshot of files in a public repository

lines.sub: The wavy marks show where time is folded, so long gaps are cut out.
lines.tts: The wavy marks show where time is folded, so long gaps are cut out.

lines.sub: At 13:41:27 UTC on 9 October, I committed the analysis plan to the public repository.
lines.tts: At thirteen forty-one and twenty-seven seconds, U T C, on the ninth of October, I committed the analysis plan to the public repository.

lines.sub: That was before this study had extracted any data.
lines.tts: That was before this study had extracted any data.

lines.sub: The lock clicks shut.
lines.tts: The lock clicks shut.

lines.sub: On the right, zoomed in to seconds, the first extraction started exactly 10 seconds later.
lines.tts: On the right, zoomed in to seconds, the first extraction started exactly ten seconds later.

lines.sub: The same day, I built the cohort and the labels, computed the same-window and W0 results, and judged rule A.
lines.tts: The same day, I built the cohort and the labels, computed the same-window and W zero results, and judged rule A.

lines.sub: We will open up rule A on the next slide.
lines.tts: We will open up rule A on the next slide.

lines.sub: After seeing those W0 results, I registered what would be tested in W1.
lines.tts: After seeing those W zero results, I registered what would be tested in W one.

lines.sub: Registering means fixing the test in public before its data are extracted.
lines.tts: Registering means fixing the test in public before its data are extracted.

lines.sub: The registration is the commit at 16:49:32.
lines.tts: The registration is the commit at sixteen forty-nine and thirty-two seconds.

lines.sub: One second later, the extraction manifest began to be written.
lines.tts: One second later, the extraction manifest began to be written.

lines.sub: 8 seconds after the commit, the logs from July to September began to be extracted.
lines.tts: Eight seconds after the commit, the logs from July to September began to be extracted.

lines.sub: The extraction script does not run without the registration commit.
lines.tts: The extraction script does not run without the registration commit.

lines.sub: And the manifest records the SHA-256 fingerprint of both files, and that the override was not used.
lines.tts: And the manifest records the S H A two fifty-six fingerprint of both files, and that the override was not used.

lines.sub: Up to here is the registered analysis.
lines.tts: Up to here is the registered analysis.

lines.sub: Everything below this dashed line happened after I knew the registered results.
lines.tts: Everything below this dashed line happened after I knew the registered results.

lines.sub: The next day, I found a problem with the units of the amounts, and I revised the amounts to US dollars.
lines.tts: The next day, I found a problem with the units of the amounts, and I revised the amounts to U S dollars.

lines.sub: This change came after seeing the registered results, so the locks on these three commits are drawn hollow.
lines.tts: This change came after seeing the registered results, so the locks on these three commits are drawn hollow.

lines.sub: I committed the revision document and the five tokens, and computed the dollar medians and percentiles.
lines.tts: I committed the revision document and the five tokens, and computed the dollar medians and percentiles.

lines.sub: Then I amended the definition of the cap U and committed it, at 11:24:01.
lines.tts: Then I amended the definition of the cap U and committed it, at eleven twenty-four and one second.

lines.sub: The pair tables, proxies, labels and revised scores were all built after this last commit.
lines.tts: The pair tables, proxies, labels and revised scores were all built after this last commit.

lines.sub: The first pair table was finished 56 seconds after that commit.
lines.tts: The first pair table was finished fifty-six seconds after that commit.

lines.sub: The plan and the registration came before this study's data extraction. That is the registered analysis.
lines.tts: The plan and the registration came before this study's data extraction. That is the registered analysis.

lines.sub: The revision came after the registered results, but it was committed before any revised score was computed.
lines.tts: The revision came after the registered results, but it was committed before any revised score was computed.

lines.sub: That is the revised analysis. A verdict that applies the registered rules to it is what I call a re-analysis.
lines.tts: That is the revised analysis. A verdict that applies the registered rules to it is what I call a re-analysis.

lines.sub: Now, rule A. I wrote it into the analysis plan, before this study extracted any data.
lines.tts: Now, rule A. I wrote it into the analysis plan, before this study extracted any data.

lines.sub: In W0, C-PR, which mixes the two edge types, must do no worse than the allowance layer walked alone, λ = 1.
lines.tts: In W zero, C P R, which mixes the two edge types, must do no worse than the allowance layer walked alone, lambda equals one.

lines.sub: At the same time, it must do better than the transfer layer walked alone, λ = 0.
lines.tts: At the same time, it must do better than the transfer layer walked alone, lambda equals zero.

lines.sub: There is also a same-window part.
lines.tts: There is also a same-window part.

lines.sub: In the chart, right of the dashed line means C-PR is better.
lines.tts: In the chart, right of the dashed line means C P R is better.

lines.sub: The numbers that will appear in this chart are a re-analysis, meaning this rule applied unchanged to the revised scores.
lines.tts: The numbers that will appear in this chart are a re-analysis, meaning this rule applied unchanged to the revised scores.

lines.sub: The first condition. On new approval pairs, the paired difference of C-PR minus the allowance layer walked alone is +0.029.
lines.tts: The first condition. On new approval pairs, the paired difference of C P R minus the allowance layer walked alone is plus zero point zero two nine.

lines.sub: The interval, from 0.022 to 0.036, lies above 0, so this condition is met.
lines.tts: The interval, from zero point zero two two to zero point zero three six, lies above zero, so this condition is met.

lines.sub: On the second condition, C-PR was actually 0.034 lower than the transfer layer.
lines.tts: On the second condition, C P R was actually zero point zero three four lower than the transfer layer.

lines.sub: The whole interval lies left of 0, so it is not met.
lines.tts: The whole interval lies left of zero, so it is not met.

lines.sub: The same-window part failed on all three counts as well.
lines.tts: The same-window part failed on all three counts as well.

lines.sub: In the small panels under the chart, on the transfer family and the allowance family, C-PR did not fall inside the interval of the better layer.
lines.tts: In the small panels under the chart, on the transfer family and the allowance family, C P R did not fall inside the interval of the better layer.

lines.sub: On Sybil stability it had to be above both layers, but at 0.142 it was below the transfer layer's 0.404.
lines.tts: On Sybil stability it had to be above both layers, but at zero point one four two it was below the transfer layer's zero point four zero four.

lines.sub: So rule A is not met.
lines.tts: So rule A is not met.

lines.sub: This verdict is a re-analysis, meaning the rule fixed in advance was applied to the revised scores.
lines.tts: This verdict is a re-analysis, meaning the rule fixed in advance was applied to the revised scores.

lines.sub: It is not a registered test.
lines.tts: It is not a registered test.

lines.sub: In the registered analysis it was not met either.
lines.tts: In the registered analysis it was not met either.

lines.sub: The gray hollow dots, just below each purple dot in the chart, show those values.
lines.tts: The gray hollow dots, just below each purple dot in the chart, show those values.

lines.sub: Next comes rule B, registered for W1.
lines.tts: Next comes rule B, registered for W one.
